You know, I really believed you last time! Well, I'm done! You know, first what happened in Neon, then all this talk about cutting me off? After all I've done for you? You're a bastard, you know that? You think you can just walk away from me like you have no use for me anymore? Well, I've got news for you. I know more than you wish I knew. items.vanilla_en:
Contributing Researcher: Dr. William Clarke

This has been a truly remarkable stop. My colleagues determined early on that this planet would be suitable for habitation. I've dedicated the majority of my time here to assessing the nearby landscape to determine the best place for future settlements.

Based on the topography of the nearby landscape, some terraforming will be required if the UC decides to establish a settlement here. However, my analysis of the bedrock suggests that it will play nice with demolition equipment. Construction teams should have no significant issues leveling large sections of terrain for building.

이번 정착지는 정말로 주목할 만했습니다. 제 동료들은 일찍이 이 행성이 거주에 적합하다고 판단했습니다. 저는 여기서 보낸 시간의 대부분을 주변 지형을 평가하여 미래 정착지에 가장 적합한 장소를 결정하는 데 주력했습니다.

주변 지형의 지형학적 특성을 고려할 때, 식민지 연합이 이곳에 정착지를 설립하기로 결정한다면 일부 행성 최적화가 필요할 것입니다. 그러나 기반암에 대한 제 분석에 따르면, 이는 철거 장비와 잘 맞을 것으로 보입니다. 건설팀은 건물을 위해 넓은 지형을 평탄화하는 데 큰 문제가 없을 것입니다.
items.genesis_en:
Contributing Researcher: Dr. William Clarke

This has been a truly remarkable stop. My colleagues determined early on that this planet would be suitable for habitation. I've dedicated the majority of my time here to assessing the nearby landscape to determine the best place for future settlements.

Based on the topography of the nearby landscape, some terraforming will be required if the Empire decides to establish a settlement here. However, my analysis of the bedrock suggests that it will play nice with demolition equipment. Construction teams should have no significant issues leveling large sections of terrain for building.

I've seen a big jump in the number of Va'ruun Zealot ships around Bluebonntet lately! If you see them, GET AWAY! You won't beat them in a fight, and they don't want to trade with us. For everybody's sake, don't tick them off!

items.vanilla_en:
Hayden Wynn 
Personal Journal
May 12, 2306

Another creature, another failure. No fault of the UC groundpounders - we wanted a predator, and they delivered. These things were SO alien, Paulson had a difficult time deciding on a designation. Opted for "Reptans Venenum."

Shame we couldn't properly sync the NCI. These things would have been spectacular. Especially the poison.
items.vanilla_ko:
헤이든 윈
개인 일지
2306년 5월 12일

또 시도하고, 또 실패한다. 식민지 연합 땅개들 잘못은 아니다. 원했던 대로 맹수를 가져다줬으니. 이번 녀석은 과하게 이질적이어서, 폴슨은 어디에 부착해야 할지를 몰랐다. '렙탄스 베네눔'에 시도해보았다.

안타깝게도 NCI 동기화는 되지 않았다. 진짜 끝내줬을텐데. 특히 맹독이 말이다.

items.vanilla_en:
Oh, Manny. You were always such a sweetheart...

But umm yeah, a couple of months ago... I kind of met someone. He works over in Neon and we sort of hit it off...

I hate to say this but after a while I really didn't think you were coming back.

------------

Can you believe it, honey?! I'm coming home!

I can't wait to hold our son. I bet he looks just like me! Hopefully, he won't be a hot head like his father and go get his arm blown off in some war haha.

I love you and can't wait to see you.
items.vanilla_ko:
오, 매니. 당신은 항상 다정했지...

하지만, 음, 몇 달 전에... 내가 다른 사람을 만났어. 네온에서 일하는 사람인데, 우리 좀 잘 맞았거든...

이런 말 하기 싫지만, 시간이 지나면서 당신이 돌아오지 않을 거라고 생각했어.

------------

여보, 믿어져?! 나 집에 간다!

우리 아들 안아보고 싶어 죽겠어. 분명 나 닮았겠지! 아빠처럼 성질 급해서 전쟁터에서 팔이 날아가는 일은 없었으면 좋겠다, 하하.

사랑하고 빨리 보고 싶어.

items.vanilla_en:
Contributing Researcher: Dr. William Clarke

This has been a truly remarkable stop. My colleagues determined early on that this planet would be suitable for habitation. I've dedicated the majority of my time here to assessing the nearby landscape to determine the best place for future settlements.

Based on the topography of the nearby landscape, some terraforming will be required if the UC decides to establish a settlement here. However, my analysis of the bedrock suggests that it will play nice with demolition equipment. Construction teams should have no significant issues leveling large sections of terrain for building.
